meta.title: Selection Quote & Comment
meta.description: Right-click selected text in conversation messages to Copy or Add to Chat (⌘L) with persistent selection highlighting, blue numbered teardrop pin badges (1, 2...), a rounded capsule comment box, and compact 'N Comments' pills with hover detail cards in both the composer and sent messages.

enabled.title: Enable Selection Quote & Comment
enabled.description: Whether to enable the selection context menu, blue pin badges, capsule comment input, and N-comments pills.

addToChatMode.title: Default Add to Chat (⌘L) Behavior
addToChatMode.description: Whether Add to Chat stages items as N-comments pills (dock) or inserts directly into the draft (direct).

commentLabel.title: Comment Prefix Label
commentLabel.description: Label prefix used when serializing comments into Markdown (default: '批注').
